facts.fact: The African Union status list of 02/02/2026 records Mozambique as having signed the Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection on 29 June 2018.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: The African Union status list of 02/02/2026 records Mozambique's ratification of the Convention on 2 December 2019 and the instrument deposited on 21 January 2020.
